<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="bn">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=5.0">
    <title>Data Analysis with Power BI & AI | Professional Data Analysis Course</title>
    <meta name="description" content="Power BI, Excel, DAX, Power Query এবং AI ব্যবহার করে practical Data Analysis শিখুন। থাকছে real-world projects, certificate এবং learning resources।">
    <meta name="keywords" content="Power BI, Data Analysis, AI, DAX, Power Query, Excel, Dashboard, Certificate, Data Analyst">
    <meta name="theme-color" content="#F2C811">
    <!-- Open Graph -->
    <meta property="og:title" content="Data Analysis with Power BI & AI">
    <meta property="og:description" content="Zero থেকে Professional Data Analyst হওয়ার জন্য Power BI + AI ভিত্তিক সম্পূর্ণ Practical Learning Program">
    <meta property="og:type" content="website">
    <meta property="og:image" content="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 1200 630'%3E%3Crect width='1200' height='630' fill='%23FFF9E6'/%3E%3Crect x='100' y='100' width='1000' height='430' rx='40' fill='%23F2C811'/%3E%3Ctext x='600' y='380' font-family='Arial' font-size='80' font-weight='bold' fill='%231a1a1a' text-anchor='middle'%3EPower BI + AI%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E">
    <!-- Twitter Card -->
    <meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">
    <meta name="twitter:title" content="Data Analysis with Power BI & AI">
    <meta name="twitter:description" content="Power BI + AI ভিত্তিক সম্পূর্ণ Practical Learning Program">
    <style>
        /* ===== RESET & BASE ===== */
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        html {
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }

        body {
            font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
            background: #FFFDF5;
            color: #1A1A1A;
            line-height: 1.6;
            overflow-x: hidden;
            -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
        }

        /* ===== CSS VARIABLES ===== */
        :root {
            --powerbi-yellow: #F2C811;
            --powerbi-gold: #D4A800;
            --powerbi-dark: #1A1A1A;
            --powerbi-charcoal: #2D2D2D;
            --powerbi-white: #FFFFFF;
            --powerbi-light: #FFFDF5;
            --powerbi-gray: #6B6B6B;
            --powerbi-gray-light: #E8E4D9;
            --powerbi-deep: #1A1A1A;
            --gradient-yellow: linear-gradient(135deg, #F2C811 0%, #D4A800 100%);
            --gradient-dark: linear-gradient(135deg, #1A1A1A 0%, #2D2D2D 100%);
            --shadow-sm: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
            --shadow-md: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
            --shadow-lg: 0 16px 48px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
            --shadow-glow: 0 0 40px rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.2);
            --radius-sm: 8px;
            --radius-md: 16px;
            --radius-lg: 24px;
            --transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
        }

        /* ===== SCROLLBAR ===== */
        ::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 8px;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
            background: #F5F0E0;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: #F2C811;
            border-radius: 4px;
        }

        /* ===== UTILITY ===== */
        .container {
            max-width: 1200px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding: 0 24px;
        }

        .section {
            padding: 80px 0;
            position: relative;
        }

        .section-title {
            font-size: 2.2rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
            letter-spacing: -0.5px;
            color: #1A1A1A;
        }

        .section-subtitle {
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            color: #6B6B6B;
            max-width: 700px;
            margin: 0 auto 48px;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .text-center {
            text-align: center;
        }

        .text-yellow {
            color: #D4A800;
        }

        /* ===== BUTTONS ===== */
        .btn {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 8px;
            padding: 14px 32px;
            border-radius: 50px;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 1rem;
            text-decoration: none;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: var(--transition);
            border: none;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .btn-primary {
            background: var(--gradient-yellow);
            color: #1A1A1A;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.4);
        }

        .btn-primary:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.55);
        }

        .btn-secondary {
            background: transparent;
            color: #1A1A1A;
            border: 2px solid #D4D0C4;
        }

        .btn-secondary:hover {
            border-color: #F2C811;
            color: #D4A800;
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            background: rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.05);
        }

        .btn-lg {
            padding: 18px 48px;
            font-size: 1.15rem;
        }

        /* ===== NAVBAR ===== */
        .navbar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            z-index: 1000;
            padding: 16px 0;
            transition: var(--transition);
            background: transparent;
        }

        .navbar.scrolled {
            background: rgba(255, 253, 245, 0.95);
            backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            padding: 10px 0;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.2);
            box-shadow: 0 2px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
        }

        .navbar .container {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
        }

        .nav-logo {
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            color: #D4A800;
            text-decoration: none;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .nav-logo span {
            color: #1A1A1A;
        }

        .nav-links {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 32px;
            list-style: none;
        }

        .nav-links a {
            color: #4A4A4A;
            text-decoration: none;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            font-weight: 500;
            transition: var(--transition);
            position: relative;
        }

        .nav-links a:hover {
            color: #D4A800;
        }

        .nav-links a::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            bottom: -4px;
            left: 0;
            width: 0;
            height: 2px;
            background: #F2C811;
            transition: var(--transition);
        }

        .nav-links a:hover::after {
            width: 100%;
        }

        .nav-cta {
            padding: 10px 24px;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
        }

        .hamburger {
            display: none;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 5px;
            cursor: pointer;
            background: none;
            border: none;
            padding: 8px;
        }

        .hamburger span {
            display: block;
            width: 24px;
            height: 2px;
            background: #1A1A1A;
            transition: var(--transition);
            border-radius: 2px;
        }

        .hamburger.active span:nth-child(1) {
            transform: rotate(45deg) translate(5px, 5px);
        }
        .hamburger.active span:nth-child(2) {
            opacity: 0;
        }
        .hamburger.active span:nth-child(3) {
            transform: rotate(-45deg) translate(5px, -5px);
        }

        /* ===== HERO ===== */
        .hero {
            min-height: 100vh;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            position: relative;
            padding: 120px 0 80px;
            background: 
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 50%, rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.12) 0%, transparent 60%),
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 20%, rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.08) 0%, transparent 50%),
                linear-gradient(180deg, #FFFDF5 0%, #FFF8E1 100%);
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .hero::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background-image: 
                linear-gradient(rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.05) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.05) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 60px 60px;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .hero-content {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 60px;
            align-items: center;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
        }

        .hero-badge {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            background: rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.15);
            border: 1px solid rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.4);
            color: #B8950A;
            padding: 8px 20px;
            border-radius: 50px;
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            margin-bottom: 24px;
            animation: pulse-glow 2s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes pulse-glow {
            0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.3); }
            50% { box-shadow: 0 0 20px 4px rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.2); }
        }

        .hero h1 {
            font-size: 3.5rem;
            font-weight: 900;
            line-height: 1.1;
            letter-spacing: -1px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            color: #1A1A1A;
        }

        .hero h1 .highlight {
            background: var(--gradient-yellow);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
        }

        .hero-sub {
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            color: #4A4A4A;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        .hero-desc {
            font-size: 0.95rem;
            color: #6B6B6B;
            margin-bottom: 32px;
            line-height: 1.7;
        }

        .hero-pricing {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 20px;
            margin-bottom: 32px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .price-regular {
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            color: #9A9A9A;
            text-decoration: line-through;
        }

        .price-early {
            font-size: 2.2rem;
            font-weight: 900;
            color: #D4A800;
        }

        .price-badge {
            background: rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.2);
            color: #B8950A;
            padding: 6px 16px;
            border-radius: 50px;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            border: 1px solid rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.4);
        }

        .hero-ctas {
            display: flex;
            gap: 16px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .hero-visual {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            position: relative;
        }

        .dashboard-mockup {
            width: 100%;
            max-width: 520px;
            background: linear-gradient(145deg, #FFFFFF, #FEFCF5);
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            border: 1px solid rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.25);
            padding: 20px;
            box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08), 0 0 40px rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.1);
            position: relative;
            animation: float 6s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes float {
            0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
            50% { transform: translateY(-12px); }
        }

        .mockup-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
        }

        .mockup-dot {
            width: 10px;
            height: 10px;
            border-radius: 50%;
        }
        .mockup-dot.red { background: #FF5F56; }
        .mockup-dot.yellow { background: #FFBD2E; }
        .mockup-dot.green { background: #27C93F; }

        .mockup-body {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 12px;
        }

        .mockup-card {
            background: rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.06);
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            padding: 16px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.12);
        }

        .mockup-card.full {
            grid-column: 1 / -1;
        }

        .mockup-label {
            font-size: 0.7rem;
            color: #8A8A8A;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .mockup-value {
            font-size: 1.5rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            color: #B8950A;
        }

        .mockup-bar {
            height: 6px;
            background: rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.15);
            border-radius: 3px;
            margin-top: 8px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .mockup-bar-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 3px;
            background: var(--gradient-yellow);
            width: 0%;
            transition: width 1.5s ease-out;
        }

        .mockup-chart {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-end;
            gap: 6px;
            height: 60px;
            margin-top: 8px;
        }

        .mockup-chart-bar {
            flex: 1;
            background: var(--gradient-yellow);
            border-radius: 3px 3px 0 0;
            min-height: 4px;
            transition: height 1s ease-out;
        }

        /* ===== URGENCY BAR ===== */
        .urgency-section {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFFDF5, #FFF8E1);
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.2);
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.2);
            padding: 40px 0;
        }

        .urgency-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 40px;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .urgency-left h3 {
            font-size: 1.6rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
            color: #1A1A1A;
        }

        .urgency-left p {
            color: #6B6B6B;
            font-size: 0.95rem;
        }

        .progress-container {
            margin-top: 16px;
        }

        .progress-label {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
            color: #6B6B6B;
        }

        .progress-track {
            height: 12px;
            background: rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.15);
            border-radius: 6px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .progress-fill {
            height: 100%;
            background: var(--gradient-yellow);
            border-radius: 6px;
            width: 0%;
            transition: width 1.5s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
            position: relative;
        }

        .progress-fill::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            bottom: 0;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,0.4), transparent);
            animation: shimmer 2s infinite;
        }

        @keyframes shimmer {
            0% { transform: translateX(-100%); }
            100% { transform: translateX(100%); }
        }

        .scarcity-badge {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            background: rgba(255, 59, 48, 0.1);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 59, 48, 0.25);
            color: #D32F2F;
            padding: 10px 24px;
            border-radius: 50px;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 0.95rem;
            animation: pulse-red 2s infinite;
        }

        @keyframes pulse-red {
            0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(255, 59, 48, 0.15); }
            50% { box-shadow: 0 0 20px 4px rgba(255, 59, 48, 0.1); }
        }

        /* ===== STICKY CTA ===== */
        .sticky-cta {
            position: fixed;
            bottom: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            background: rgba(255, 253, 245, 0.98);
            backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.3);
            padding: 12px 24px;
            z-index: 999;
            display: none;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            gap: 16px;
            transform: translateY(100%);
            transition: transform 0.4s ease;
            box-shadow: 0 -4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
        }

        .sticky-cta.visible {
            transform: translateY(0);
        }

        .sticky-cta .price-info {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
        }

        .sticky-cta .price-info .current {
            font-size: 1.3rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            color: #D4A800;
        }

        .sticky-cta .price-info .old {
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            color: #9A9A9A;
            text-decoration: line-through;
        }

        /* ===== CARDS ===== */
        .card {
            background: #FFFFFF;
            border: 1px solid #E8E4D9;
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            padding: 32px;
            transition: var(--transition);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
        }

        .card::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 3px;
            background: var(--gradient-yellow);
            transform: scaleX(0);
            transform-origin: left;
            transition: transform 0.4s ease;
        }

        .card:hover::before {
            transform: scaleX(1);
        }

        .card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-4px);
            border-color: rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.3);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
        }

        /* ===== COURSE OVERVIEW ===== */
        .overview-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr));
            gap: 20px;
        }

        .overview-card {
            background: #FFFFFF;
            border: 1px solid #E8E4D9;
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            padding: 28px 24px;
            text-align: center;
            transition: var(--transition);
            position: relative;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
        }

        .overview-card:hover {
            background: #FFFDF5;
            border-color: rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.3);
            transform: translateY(-4px);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
        }

        .overview-step {
            width: 48px;
            height: 48px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.15);
            border: 2px solid rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.4);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            margin: 0 auto 16px;
            font-weight: 800;
            color: #B8950A;
            font-size: 1rem;
        }

        .overview-card h4 {
            font-size: 0.95rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
            color: #1A1A1A;
        }

        .overview-card p {
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            color: #6B6B6B;
        }

        /* ===== CURRICULUM ===== */
        .curriculum-modules {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 12px;
        }

        .module {
            background: #FFFFFF;
            border: 1px solid #E8E4D9;
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            overflow: hidden;
            transition: var(--transition);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
        }

        .module:hover {
            border-color: rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.3);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
        }

        .module-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding: 20px 28px;
            cursor: pointer;
            user-select: none;
            transition: var(--transition);
        }

        .module-header:hover {
            background: rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.04);
        }

        .module-header-left {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 16px;
        }

        .module-number {
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            color: #B8950A;
            background: rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.15);
            padding: 4px 12px;
            border-radius: 50px;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .module-title {
            font-size: 1rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: #1A1A1A;
        }

        .module-toggle {
            width: 28px;
            height: 28px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.1);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            transition: var(--transition);
            flex-shrink: 0;
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            color: #B8950A;
        }

        .module.active .module-toggle {
            transform: rotate(45deg);
            background: rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.25);
        }

        .module-body {
            max-height: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
            transition: max-height 0.4s ease;
        }

        .module-body-inner {
            padding: 0 28px 24px;
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .topic-tag {
            background: #F8F6EF;
            border: 1px solid #E8E4D9;
            padding: 6px 14px;
            border-radius: 50px;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            color: #4A4A4A;
            transition: var(--transition);
        }

        .topic-tag:hover {
            background: rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.12);
            border-color: rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.3);
            color: #B8950A;
        }

        /* ===== CERTIFICATE ===== */
        .certificate-section {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFFDF5 0%, #FFF8E1 100%);
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.2);
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.2);
        }

        .certificate-wrapper {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 60px;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .certificate-content h2 {
            font-size: 2.2rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
            color: #1A1A1A;
        }

        .certificate-content > p {
            font-size: 1rem;
            color: #6B6B6B;
            margin-bottom: 24px;
            line-height: 1.7;
        }

        .certificate-features {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 14px;
        }

        .cert-feature {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-start;
            gap: 12px;
            padding: 14px 18px;
            background: #FFFFFF;
            border: 1px solid #E8E4D9;
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            transition: var(--transition);
        }

        .cert-feature:hover {
            border-color: rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.4);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
        }

        .cert-feature-icon {
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            margin-top: 2px;
        }

        .cert-feature-text {
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            color: #4A4A4A;
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .certificate-visual {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .certificate-card {
            width: 100%;
            max-width: 460px;
            background: #FFFFFF;
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            border: 2px solid rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.4);
            padding: 36px 32px;
            box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08), 0 0 40px rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.15);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .certificate-card::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 6px;
            background: var(--gradient-yellow);
        }

        .certificate-card::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 6px;
            background: var(--gradient-yellow);
        }

        .cert-logo {
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            color: #D4A800;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }

        .cert-title {
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 3px;
            color: #8A8A8A;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .cert-course {
            font-size: 1.3rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            color: #1A1A1A;
            margin-bottom: 24px;
            line-height: 1.3;
        }

        .cert-divider {
            width: 60px;
            height: 3px;
            background: var(--gradient-yellow);
            margin: 0 auto 24px;
            border-radius: 2px;
        }

        .cert-recipient {
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            color: #8A8A8A;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
        }

        .cert-name {
            font-size: 1.4rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: #1A1A1A;
            margin-bottom: 24px;
            font-style: italic;
        }

        .cert-footer {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: flex-end;
            margin-top: 28px;
            padding-top: 20px;
            border-top: 1px dashed #E8E4D9;
        }

        .cert-sign {
            text-align: left;
        }

        .cert-sign-line {
            width: 100px;
            height: 1px;
            background: #1A1A1A;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
        }

        .cert-sign-label {
            font-size: 0.7rem;
            color: #8A8A8A;
        }

        .cert-seal {
            width: 56px;
            height: 56px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--gradient-yellow);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 1.5rem;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.4);
        }

        /* ===== TOOLS ===== */
        .tools-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr));
            gap: 20px;
        }

        .tool-card {
            background: #FFFFFF;
            border: 1px solid #E8E4D9;
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            padding: 32px 24px;
            text-align: center;
            transition: var(--transition);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
        }

        .tool-card:hover {
            background: #FFFDF5;
            border-color: rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.3);
            transform: translateY(-4px);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
        }

        .tool-icon {
            font-size: 2.5rem;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
            display: block;
        }

        .tool-card h4 {
            font-size: 1rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
            color: #1A1A1A;
        }

        .tool-card p {
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            color: #6B6B6B;
        }

        /* ===== RESOURCES ===== */
        .resources-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr));
            gap: 20px;
        }

        .resource-card {
            background: #FFFFFF;
            border: 1px solid #E8E4D9;
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            padding: 28px;
            transition: var(--transition);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
        }

        .resource-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-4px);
            border-color: rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.3);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
        }

        .resource-type {
            font-size: 0.7rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: #B8950A;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .resource-card h4 {
            font-size: 1rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
            color: #1A1A1A;
        }

        .resource-card p {
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            color: #6B6B6B;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
        }

        .resource-link {
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            color: #B8950A;
            text-decoration: none;
            font-weight: 600;
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 4px;
            transition: var(--transition);
        }

        .resource-link:hover {
            gap: 8px;
            color: #D4A800;
        }

        /* ===== AUDIENCE ===== */
        .audience-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr));
            gap: 16px;
        }

        .audience-card {
            background: #FFFFFF;
            border: 1px solid #E8E4D9;
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            padding: 24px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 14px;
            transition: var(--transition);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
        }

        .audience-card:hover {
            background: #FFFDF5;
            border-color: rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.3);
            transform: translateX(4px);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
        }

        .audience-icon {
            font-size: 1.8rem;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .audience-card span {
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: #1A1A1A;
        }

        .not-for-list {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 12px;
            max-width: 600px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        .not-for-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
            padding: 16px 24px;
            background: rgba(255, 59, 48, 0.04);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 59, 48, 0.12);
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            color: #4A4A4A;
        }

        /* ===== OUTCOMES ===== */
        .outcomes-list {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr));
            gap: 12px;
            max-width: 900px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        .outcome-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
            padding: 14px 20px;
            background: #FFFFFF;
            border: 1px solid #E8E4D9;
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            transition: var(--transition);
            color: #1A1A1A;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
        }

        .outcome-item:hover {
            background: #FFFDF5;
            border-color: rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.3);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
        }

        .outcome-check {
            color: #D4A800;
            font-weight: 800;
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        /* ===== PROJECTS ===== */
        .projects-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr));
            gap: 24px;
        }

        .project-card {
            background: #FFFFFF;
            border: 1px solid #E8E4D9;
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            overflow: hidden;
            transition: var(--transition);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
        }

        .project-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-6px);
            border-color: rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.3);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
        }

        .project-image {
            height: 160px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #F8F6EF, #FFF8E1);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .project-image::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 60%;
            background: linear-gradient(transparent, #FFFFFF);
        }

        .project-mock {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-end;
            gap: 8px;
            height: 80px;
            padding: 0 24px;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
        }

        .project-mock-bar {
            flex: 1;
            background: var(--gradient-yellow);
            border-radius: 4px 4px 0 0;
            opacity: 0.7;
            transition: var(--transition);
        }

        .project-card:hover .project-mock-bar {
            opacity: 1;
        }

        .project-body {
            padding: 24px;
        }

        .project-body h4 {
            font-size: 1rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
            color: #1A1A1A;
        }

        .project-body p {
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            color: #6B6B6B;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
        }

        .project-skills {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 6px;
        }

        .project-skill {
            font-size: 0.7rem;
            background: rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.12);
            color: #B8950A;
            padding: 4px 10px;
            border-radius: 50px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.25);
        }

        /* ===== FEATURES ===== */
        .features-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr));
            gap: 12px;
            max-width: 900px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        .feature-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
            padding: 12px 16px;
            background: #FFFFFF;
            border: 1px solid #E8E4D9;
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            transition: var(--transition);
            color: #1A1A1A;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
        }

        .feature-item:hover {
            background: #FFFDF5;
            border-color: rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.3);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
        }

        .feature-check {
            color: #D4A800;
            font-weight: 800;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        /* ===== PRICING ===== */
        .pricing-card {
            max-width: 520px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            background: #FFFFFF;
            border: 2px solid rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.4);
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            padding: 48px;
            text-align: center;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08), 0 0 40px rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.15);
        }

        .pricing-card::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 4px;
            background: var(--gradient-yellow);
        }

        .pricing-badge {
            display: inline-block;
            background: rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.15);
            color: #B8950A;
            padding: 6px 18px;
            border-radius: 50px;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.35);
        }

        .pricing-old {
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            color: #9A9A9A;
            text-decoration: line-through;
            margin-bottom: 4px;
        }

        .pricing-new {
            font-size: 3.5rem;
            font-weight: 900;
            color: #D4A800;
            line-height: 1;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .pricing-save {
            display: inline-block;
            background: rgba(39, 201, 63, 0.1);
            color: #1B8A2F;
            padding: 4px 14px;
            border-radius: 50px;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: 24px;
        }

        .pricing-highlight {
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            color: #4A4A4A;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .pricing-scarcity {
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            color: #D32F2F;
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: 28px;
        }

        .pricing-trust {
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            color: #8A8A8A;
            margin-top: 16px;
        }

        /* ===== COUNTDOWN ===== */
        .countdown {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 20px;
            margin: 40px 0;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .countdown-item {
            text-align: center;
            min-width: 80px;
        }

        .countdown-value {
            font-size: 2.5rem;
            font-weight: 900;
            color: #D4A800;
            line-height: 1;
            font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        }

        .countdown-label {
            font-size: 0.7rem;
            color: #8A8A8A;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            margin-top: 6px;
        }

        .countdown-ended {
            font-size: 1.5rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            color: #D32F2F;
            padding: 20px;
            background: rgba(255, 59, 48, 0.08);
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 59, 48, 0.2);
        }

        /* ===== FAQ ===== */
        .faq-list {
            max-width: 800px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 12px;
        }

        .faq-item {
            background: #FFFFFF;
            border: 1px solid #E8E4D9;
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            overflow: hidden;
            transition: var(--transition);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
        }

        .faq-item.active {
            border-color: rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.4);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
        }

        .faq-question {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding: 20px 24px;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 0.95rem;
            transition: var(--transition);
            user-select: none;
            color: #1A1A1A;
        }

        .faq-question:hover {
            background: rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.04);
        }

        .faq-icon {
            font-size: 1.3rem;
            color: #B8950A;
            transition: var(--transition);
            flex-shrink: 0;
            margin-left: 16px;
        }

        .faq-item.active .faq-icon {
            transform: rotate(45deg);
        }

        .faq-answer {
            max-height: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
            transition: max-height 0.4s ease;
        }

        .faq-answer-inner {
            padding: 0 24px 20px;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            color: #6B6B6B;
            line-height: 1.7;
        }

        /* ===== ENROLLMENT ===== */
        .enrollment-section {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFFDF5 0%, #FFF8E1 100%);
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.2);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .enrollment-section::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: -50%;
            left: -50%;
            width: 200%;
            height: 200%;
            background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 50%, rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.06) 0%, transparent 50%);
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .enrollment-content {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .enrollment-content h2 {
            font-size: 2.5rem;
            font-weight: 900;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
            color: #1A1A1A;
        }

        .enrollment-content .sub {
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            color: #6B6B6B;
            margin-bottom: 32px;
            line-height: 1.8;
        }

        .enrollment-price {
            font-size: 3rem;
            font-weight: 900;
            color: #D4A800;
            margin-bottom: 24px;
        }

        .enrollment-urgency {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 20px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            margin-top: 20px;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            color: #4A4A4A;
        }

        /* ===== FOOTER ===== */
        .footer {
            background: #1A1A1A;
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.15);
            padding: 60px 0 30px;
            color: #B0B0B0;
        }

        .footer-content {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 40px;
            margin-bottom: 40px;
        }

        .footer-brand h3 {
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            color: #F2C811;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .footer-brand p {
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            color: #8A8A8A;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
        }

        .footer-links h4 {
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
            color: #FFFFFF;
        }

        .footer-links ul {
            list-style: none;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 10px;
        }

        .footer-links a {
            color: #8A8A8A;
            text-decoration: none;
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            transition: var(--transition);
        }

        .footer-links a:hover {
            color: #F2C811;
        }

        .footer-bottom {
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
            padding-top: 24px;
            text-align: center;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            color: #6A6A6A;
        }

        /* ===== ANIMATIONS ===== */
        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(30px);
            transition: opacity 0.6s ease, transform 0.6s ease;
        }

        .reveal.visible {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateY(0);
        }

        .reveal-delay-1 { transition-delay: 0.1s; }
        .reveal-delay-2 { transition-delay: 0.2s; }
        .reveal-delay-3 { transition-delay: 0.3s; }
        .reveal-delay-4 { transition-delay: 0.4s; }

        /* ===== RESPONSIVE ===== */
        @media (max-width: 1024px) {
            .hero-content {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
                gap: 40px;
            }

            .hero h1 {
                font-size: 2.8rem;
            }

            .hero-visual {
                order: -1;
            }

            .dashboard-mockup {
                max-width: 100%;
            }

            .urgency-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
                gap: 24px;
            }

            .certificate-wrapper {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
                gap: 40px;
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .section {
                padding: 60px 0;
            }

            .section-title {
                font-size: 1.7rem;
            }

            .hero {
                padding: 100px 0 60px;
                min-height: auto;
            }

            .hero h1 {
                font-size: 2.2rem;
            }

            .hero-sub {
                font-size: 1rem;
            }

            .hero-pricing {
                flex-direction: column;
                align-items: flex-start;
                gap: 8px;
            }

            .hero-ctas {
                flex-direction: column;
            }

            .hero-ctas .btn {
                width: 100%;
            }

            .nav-links {
                display: none;
                position: absolute;
                top: 100%;
                left: 0;
                width: 100%;
                background: rgba(255, 253, 245, 0.98);
                backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
                flex-direction: column;
                padding: 24px;
                gap: 20px;
                border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(242, 200, 17, 0.2);
                box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
            }

            .nav-links.open {
                display: flex;
            }

            .nav-links .nav-cta {
                width: 100%;
                text-align: center;
            }

            .hamburger {
                display: flex;
            }

            .sticky-cta {
                display: flex;
            }

            .pricing-card {
                padding: 32px 24px;
            }

            .pricing-new {
                font-size: 2.8rem;
            }

            .countdown-value {
                font-size: 2rem;
            }

            .countdown-item {
                min-width: 60px;
            }

            .footer-content {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
                gap: 32px;
            }

            .enrollment-content h2 {
                font-size: 1.8rem;
            }

            .enrollment-price {
                font-size: 2.2rem;
            }

            .mockup-body {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }

            .overview-grid {
                grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            }

            .module-header {
                padding: 16px 20px;
            }

            .module-body-inner {
                padding: 0 20px 20px;
            }

            .certificate-content h2 {
                font-size: 1.7rem;
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 480px) {
            .container {
                padding: 0 16px;
            }

            .hero h1 {
                font-size: 1.8rem;
            }

            .section-title {
                font-size: 1.4rem;
            }

            .overview-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }

            .tools-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            }

            .audience-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }

            .outcomes-list {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }

            .features-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }

            .countdown {
                gap: 12px;
            }

            .countdown-value {
                font-size: 1.6rem;
            }

            .countdown-item {
                min-width: 50px;
            }

            .btn-lg {
                padding: 14px 32px;
                font-size: 1rem;
                width: 100%;
            }

            .certificate-card {
                padding: 24px 20px;
            }

            .cert-course {
                font-size: 1.1rem;
            }

            .cert-name {
                font-size: 1.2rem;
            }
        }

        /* ===== REDUCED MOTION ===== */
        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            * {
                animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
                transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
            }
            .reveal {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: none;
            }
        }

        /* ===== ACCESSIBILITY ===== */
        .sr-only {
            position: absolute;
            width: 1px;
            height: 1px;
            padding: 0;
            margin: -1px;
            overflow: hidden;
            clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
            border: 0;

/* ============================================
   COUNTDOWN TIMER
   ============================================ */
function initCountdown() {
    const endDate = new Date(courseConfig.offerEndDate).getTime();

    function update() {
        const now = new Date().getTime();
        const diff = endDate - now;

        if (diff <= 0) {
            document.getElementById('countdownTimer').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('countdownEnded').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }

        const days = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
        const hours = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
        const minutes = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
        const seconds = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);

        document.getElementById('days').textContent = String(days).padStart(2, '0');
        document.getElementById('hours').textContent = String(hours).padStart(2, '0');
        document.getElementById('minutes').textContent = String(minutes).padStart(2, '0');
        document.getElementById('seconds').textContent = String(seconds).padStart(2, '0');
    }

    update();
    setInterval(update, 1000);
}

/* ============================================
   SCROLL REVEAL (Intersection Observer)
   ============================================ */
function initReveal() {
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        entries.forEach(entry => {
            if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                entry.target.classList.add('visible');
            }
        });
    }, {
        threshold: 0.1,
        rootMargin: '0px 0px -50px 0px'
    });

    document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
}

/* ============================================
   MOCKUP ANIMATIONS
   ============================================ */
function initMockupAnimations() {
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        entries.forEach(entry => {
            if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                entry.target.querySelectorAll('.mockup-bar-fill').forEach(bar => {
                    const width = bar.getAttribute('data-width');
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        bar.style.width = width;
                    }, 400);
                });
                entry.target.querySelectorAll('.mockup-chart-bar').forEach((bar, i) => {
                    const height = bar.getAttribute('data-height');
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        bar.style.height = height;
                    }, 300 + i * 100);
                });
                observer.unobserve(entry.target);
            }
        });
    }, { threshold: 0.5 });

    const mockup = document.querySelector('.dashboard-mockup');
    if (mockup) observer.observe(mockup);
}
